content: The King of Aspiration Prayers: Samantabhadra's Aspiration to Good ActionsHomage to the noble youthful Mañjuśrī.To all the lions among men, the Tathāgatas of the three times,In as many worlds as exist throughout the ten directions,To every one of them without exception,I pay homage with a pure mind, body, and speech.By the power of this prayer for excellent conduct,With all the Victors appearing vividly before my mind,And bowing with bodies as numerous as the atoms of the realms,I prostrate deeply to all the Victors.Upon a single atom are Buddhas as numerous as all atoms,Each sitting in the midst of their Bodhisattva heirs;In this way, I imagine the entire expanse of the realm of phenomena,To be completely filled with Victorious Ones.With oceans of inexhaustible praise for them,And through the sounds of oceans of melodic factors,I express the qualities of all the Victorious Ones,And I praise all those who have gone to bliss.With the finest flowers and the finest garlands,With cymbals, scented ointments, and supreme parasols,With the most excellent lamps and the finest incense,I make offerings to those Victorious Ones.With the finest garments and supreme fragrances,With mounds of powdered incense as high as Mount Meru,And with every kind of outstanding and sublime array,I make offerings to those Victorious Ones.With offerings that are unsurpassed and vast,And with deep devotion for all the Victorious Ones,Through the power of faith in the Conduct of Excellence,I prostrate and make offerings to all the Victors.Driven by the power of desire, hatred, and ignorance,Through body, speech, and likewise through the mind,Whatever negative actions I have committed,All of these I individually confess.To all the Victors of the ten directions and the Buddha’s sons,To the Pratyekabuddhas, those in training, and those beyond training,And to the merit of all wandering beings—In all of that merit, I rejoice.To those who are the lamps of the worlds in the ten directions,Who have attained the non-clinging Buddhahood through the stages of awakening,To all those Protectors, I make this request:Turn the unsurpassed wheel of Dharma.To those who intend to demonstrate passing into nirvana,For the sake of the benefit and happiness of all wandering beings,I pray with palms joined togetherThat they remain for as many eons as there are atoms in the realms.Through prostrating, offering, and confessing,Through rejoicing, exhorting, and praying,Whatever slight virtue I have accumulated,I dedicate it all for the sake of enlightenment.May offerings be made to the Buddhas of the past and to all thoseWho dwell in the worlds of the ten directions;May those who have not yet come swiftly fulfill their aspirations,And proceed through the stages of awakening to manifest as Buddhas.However many realms there are in the ten directions,May they all become extensively and completely pure.May they be filled with Victors who have gone to the foot of the sovereign Bodhi tree,And with the multitude of the children of the Buddhas.However many sentient beings there are in the ten directions,May they always be free from illness and happy.May the Dharma aims of all living beingsBe met with harmony, and may all their hopes be fulfilled.As I practice the conduct of enlightenment,May I remember my past lives in all states of existence.In all my successive lives, through death and rebirth,May I always renounce the worldly life and take ordination.Following in the footsteps of all the Victors,May I bring the Conduct of Excellence to full perfection.With a conduct of ethical discipline that is stainless and completely pure,May I always act without ever failing and remain free from fault.In the languages of gods, nāgas, and yakṣas,In the tongues of kumbhāṇḍas and of humans,And in as many voices as there are among all living beings,I shall teach the Dharma in all their languages.Diligently training in the perfections,May I never forget the bodhi-mind;May all those non-virtues that act as obscurationsBe completely purified without exception.Freed from karma, afflictions, and the works of Māra,May I act within the worlds of living beingsJust as a lotus is unsullied by water,Or as the sun and moon move unhindered through the sky.Throughout the extent and directions of the fields,I shall thoroughly pacify the suffering of the lower realms;I shall establish all beings in happiness,And act for the benefit of every living creature.Fully completing the conduct of enlightenment,I shall engage in accordance with the behavior of sentient beings;Demonstrating the conduct of excellence,I shall practice throughout all future eons.May I always associate with thoseWhose conduct is similar to my own;Through body, speech, and also mind,May we practice our deeds and aspirations as one.May I always meet those friends who wish to benefit me,Those who clearly demonstrate the conduct of excellence;May I always encounter them,And may I never disappoint their minds.May I always behold the Victors, the Protectors,Surrounded by the Sons of the Buddhas;Without ever becoming weary throughout all future eons,May I also make vast offerings to them.May I uphold the holy Dharma of the Victors,And make the conduct of enlightenment appear everywhere;May I thoroughly purify the conduct of excellence,And practice it throughout all future eons.As I wander through all states of existence,May I attain inexhaustible merit and wisdom;May I become an inexhaustible treasury of all qualities—Of skillful means, wisdom, samādhi, and liberation.Upon a single atom are lands as numerous as atoms,And in those lands dwell inconceivable Buddhas;Seated in the midst of their Bodhisattva heirs,May I practice the conduct of enlightenment and behold them.Thus, in every direction without exception,Within the space of a single hair, there are oceans of Buddhas,Oceans of realms, and oceans of eons;I shall practice and enter into them all.With the sounds of an ocean of qualities in a single word,The pure melody of the voices of all the Victors,A resonance that accords with the inclinations of all beings,May I always engage with the speech of the Buddhas.All the Victors who have gone throughout the three times,As they perfectly turn the wheels of Dharma,Into their inexhaustible melodies of speech,I shall also enter by the power of my intellect.I shall enter into all future eons in a single instant,And in a single instant, I too shall enter into them;Whatever the measure of the eons of the three times,I shall practice by entering them in a mere fraction of a moment.In a single instant, I shall behold all those lions among menWho have appeared throughout the three times;I shall always enter their sphere of activityThrough the power of a liberation that is like an illusion.Whatever arrays of realms there are in the three times,I shall manifest them upon a single atom;In that way, in every direction without exception,I shall enter into the arrays of the Victors' realms.Those lamps of the world who have not yet arrived,Who will successively attain buddhahood and turn the wheel,And demonstrate the ultimate peace of final nirvana—Into the presence of all those Protectors, I shall go.Through the power of miracles that are swift in all ways,Through the power of the vehicle that is a gateway in all ways,Through the power of conduct that possesses qualities in all ways,And through the power of loving-kindness that is all-pervasive,Through the power of merit that is virtuous in all ways,And the power of primordial wisdom that is free from attachment,Through the power of wisdom, skillful means, and meditative concentration,I shall perfectly accomplish the powers of enlightenment.I shall thoroughly purify the power of karma,I shall utterly destroy the power of afflictions,I shall render the power of the maras powerless,And I shall bring the power of noble conduct to full perfection.I shall completely purify oceans of realms,I shall completely liberate oceans of sentient beings,I shall clearly perceive oceans of Dharmas,And I shall thoroughly realize oceans of primordial wisdom.I shall completely purify oceans of conduct,I shall fully perfect oceans of aspirational prayers,I shall make extensive offerings to oceans of Buddhas,And I shall practice without weariness throughout oceans of eons.Whatever specific aspirations for the conduct of awakeningThe Victorious Ones who depart throughout the three times have made,Once I have attained the awakening of buddhahood through the conduct of Samantabhadra,I shall fulfill them all entirely without exception.To the eldest son of all the Victorious Ones,Whose name is called Samantabhadra,In order to practice in a way equal to that wise one,I thoroughly dedicate all these virtues.With body, speech, and mind entirely pure,With pure conduct and entirely pure realms,Just as the wise one’s dedication is excellent,May I also become equal to that.In order to practice the excellence of virtue in every way,I shall practice the aspiration prayers of Mañjuśrī.Without ever becoming weary throughout all future eons,I shall perfectly fulfill all his activities without exception.May my conduct be without any limit,And may my qualities also be beyond measure.By abiding in such immeasurable conduct,May I master all their miraculous emanations.Just as the reaches of space are endless,So too is the extent of sentient beings without exception;As far as the ends of karma and afflictions extend,May the limits of my aspirations reach that far as well.If one were to offer to the Victors all the infinite realms of the ten directions,Adorned with jewels, and even the supreme joys of gods and humansFor as many eons as there are atoms in those realms,That would be surpassed by this.Whoever hears this King of Dedication prayers,And feels a deep longing for supreme enlightenment,Generating faith even for a single moment,Will attain the most excellent and sacred merit.Whoever makes this Prayer of Excellent Conduct,Will thereby abandon all lower realms.They will have left behind all negative companions,And will quickly behold the Buddha of Boundless Light.They will gain the supreme gain and live in happiness;Even in this life, all will go well for them.Before long, they will become just asThe noble Samantabhadra himself.Even the sins of the five inexpiable crimes,Committed through the power of ignorance,Will be swiftly and completely purifiedIf one recites this Prayer of Excellent Conduct.They will be endowed with wisdom, fine form, and the major marks,Possessing a noble lineage and a radiant complexion.Many demons and heretics will be unable to overcome them,And they will be honored throughout all the three worlds.They will swiftly go to the foot of the king of Bodhi trees;Having gone there, they will sit for the benefit of sentient beings,Attain enlightenment, turn the wheel of the Buddha’s Dharma,And subdue all the Maras along with their hosts.Whoever upholds, teaches, or reads this Prayer of Excellent Conduct,The full ripening of its result is known only to the Buddhas;Therefore, do not harbor any doubtRegarding the attainment of supreme enlightenment.Just as the hero Mañjuśrī knows,And Samantabhadra does as well,I shall train by following in their footsteps,And perfectly dedicate all these virtues.With that dedication which is praised as supremeBy all the Victorious Ones who have gone throughout the three times,I also dedicate all these roots of my virtueToward the practice of Excellent Conduct.When the time comes for me to pass away,Having completely cleared away all obscurations,And seeing Amitābha directly before me,May I proceed to that realm of Sukhāvatī.Having gone there, may all these very prayersBe realized in their entirety, without exception;May I fulfill them all completely,And act for the benefit of sentient beings for as long as the world endures.In that excellent and joyous mandala of the Victor,Born from a most beautiful and sacred lotus,May I receive there a direct prophecyFrom the Victorious One, Amitābha.Having received that sublime prophecy there,Through hundreds of millions of emanations,And by the power of my intelligence throughout the ten directions,May I perform many benefits for sentient beings.Whatever slight virtue I have accumulatedBy offering this Prayer of Excellent Conduct,May all the virtuous prayers of living beingsBe fulfilled in a single instant.Through the supreme and boundless merit gainedBy dedicating this Prayer of Excellent Conduct,May all beings drowning in the river of sufferingAttain the sublime realm of Amitābha.This King of Prayers is the most supreme,Benefiting all infinite wandering beings;Having completed this text adorned by Samantabhadra,May the lower realms be emptied without exception.The Noble King of Prayers of Excellent Conduct is concluded.
